# Music Player Proxy

A music player that proxies external audio using React. Stream music within your Discord Activity.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/react-music-proxy-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Audio playback controls
- External audio proxying
- TypeScript support

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
